description:
It has been 10 years since Yeon-cho, who can see ghosts, came to Taeshindang, and 3 years since she started harboring a one-sided crush on the willful deity, Cha Bum-young. Running the shrine, greeting clients, and waiting on the deity hand and foot—not a single day goes by in peace while staying by his side. Yet, completely oblivious to Yeon-cho's burning heart, Bum-young stirs her emotions with irritating remarks and a smile. 

"I'm dying of anxiety over here; why is he so relaxed?" 

A deity's heart is more unfathomable than any ghost. Will Yeon-cho finally be able to open the door to her long-standing unrequited love?
